label: Post cards
description: The blog's post grid. Each card names one post by its slug and shows that post's own record from site/blog/posts/ — its topic, date, title, link, excerpt and featured image. Nothing on a card is a second copy of a post, so a featured image set on Posts is the image both this card and that post's page draw, and it can only ever belong to that post. Which posts appear, and in what order, is the page's to choose; `node tools/blog-sync/sync.mjs` refills the rest from the records and `npm run check` fails if a card has drifted from the post it names. Each card also carries the topic the platform filter behaviour reads, so the topic chips need no script, and the grid owns the “no posts in this topic” message the behaviour reveals when a chip matches nothing. A post with no featured image draws an empty placeholder the same size as the photograph, so adding one later does not move the card.

props.label: Message when a topic has no posts
props.default: No posts in this topic yet.

fields.label: Post slug — which post in Posts this card shows
Topic — from the post; must match a chip value
Featured image — set on Posts → this post, not here
